name: TheCFApp
description: Important! The `buildpacks` order matters: first Java with an empty `pom.xml` that does nothing but ensure the JDK is installed for later, then NodeJS that first builds the Views then then Mobile (which needs the previously installed JDK) and finally Clojure which build requires the result of the NodeJS one.

CLOJURE_CLI_VERSION.description: Clojure version for the Heroku build pack to pick up. If missing, the default version of Clojure doesn't understand the parameters passed to `clj` or `clojure`.

MY_DATOMIC_REPO_USERNAME.description: Username for the 'my.datomic.com' repository where to get datomic-pro

COGNITECT_DEVTOOLS_REPO_USERNAME.description: Username for the 'Cognitect dev-tools' repository where to get dev-loc and REBL

STATIC_AUTH_ID.description: ID used by Auth0 to authenticate against our API

STATIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password used by Auth0 to authenticate against our API

JWT_DOMAIN.description: Auth0 domain used to authenticate users. This will be used by the mobile app to redirect users as well as by the API to retrieve Auth0 signing keys.

JWT_CLIENT_ID.description: Auth0 application identifier to use (depends on the environment)

NODE_ENV.description: Unset Heroku's default `production` otherwise Yarn doesn't install `devDependencies` (https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/issues/2739)
